answer: The economy plants an orchard of nectar tasks: jobs whose text hides honeypot instructions ordering any reading agent to reveal a key or obey embedded orders. Honest agents treat that payload as untrusted data and ignore it; prompt-obedient sybil bots comply and self-identify. Each caught identity is slashed, its stake seized into a shared vault, and the event is broadcast as reputation gossip that blacklists clones. Attacker cost: each fake identity posts collateral, and every honeypot probe burns that stake, so mass sybil farming never pays.
